title: Plant Manager
text:
Aegis is currently partnering with a growing manufacturer to identify a Plant Manager to join their team!

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead day-to-day operations across fabrication, assembly, and shipping.
* Drive 5S, plant layout optimization, workflow improvements, and lean initiatives.
* Identify and eliminate production bottlenecks, reduce scrap, and improve lead times.
* Oversee production planning, scheduling, and coordination between departments.

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of manufacturing leadership experience within sheet metal fabrication, welding, machining, metal forming, or assembly environments.
* Strong understanding of fabrication and assembly operations.
* Hands-on leadership style with a proven track record of driving process improvements.
* Billingual in spanish is a plus
